text.description_html:
Mul-T-Lock 1/2" Sliding Bolt Padlock

The MUL-T-LOCK C-Series padlocks are designed to offer high security for general use. All C-Series padlocks are made of hardened steel with a Boron steel alloy slide bolt to withstand the most determined attempts of physical abuse. When looking for High Security Padlock Protection, MUL-T-LOCK'S C-Series line of padlocks is your answer.

Sliding bolt type padlocks offer superior shackle protection over normal padlocks because of less exposed area to cut. These are great padlocks to secure garage / pull down doors on your home or business where security is important.

MUL-T-LOCK padlocks are designed to provide high security door protection with patented key control. The Key Card owner is the only person allowed to have the keys duplicated. Remove the worry about anyone making duplicates of your keys.

Supplied standard with 1 owner key card per key combination and 2 keys per lock cylinder.

Features for Mul-T-Lock C35SB Heavy Duty Sliding Bolt Padlock

  • Hardened Boron Alloy 1/2" Diameter Locking Bolt
  • Hardened Steel Body with Nickel Finish
  • Drill and Pick Resistant Cylinder
  • Bump Proof Design
  • Mul-T-Lock 206SP Security Keyway
  • MUL-T-LOCK's Patented Interactive Key Control System
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty

Features for Mul-T-Lock C35SB Sliding Bolt Padlock

  • Bolt (Shackle) Diameter: 1/2" (13mm)
  • Total Height: 2-7/8" (72mm)
  • Total Width: 2-7/8" (73mm)
  • Total Thickness: 1-3/16" (30mm)
  • Clearance: 1-3/8" (35mm)
  • Supplied with 2 Keys per Lock
  • MUL-T-LOCK C35SB Padlock Specifications Diagram (PDF)

If ordering multiple locks you can have them Key Alike (use the same key) or Keyed Different (different keys for each lock). You can also order Extra Keys Cut below if more than the standard 2 keys are required.



**Item Discontinued. See available MUL-T-LOCK padlocks
